name: portable-review
description: Portable file walk-in: recon -> two-way fan-out review -> summary. No code, no secrets; drop anywhere and run graph_path=<abs path>.

nodes.goal: List the two most important files in the current directory. Reply with exactly this JSON shape and nothing else: {"files": ["<path>", "<path>"]}

fanout.goal: Review {item} in one paragraph: what it does and one concrete risk. Reply exactly: {"file": "{item}", "finding": "<one paragraph>"}

nodes.goal: Merge the review findings into a three-line summary. Reply exactly: {"summary": "<three lines>"}
